figurative_meaning_en: The ability to hear the prayers of the supplicant
example_sentences_in_bangla: সরকারের গণেশের কান নেই, জনগণের কণ্ঠস্বর শোনে না।
আমাদের প্রধানের কাছে গণেশের কান আছে, তাই সবাই তার কাছে আসে।
example_sentences_in_english: The government has no Ganesha's ear; it doesn't listen to the people's voices.
Our leader has Ganesha's ear, so everyone approaches him with requests.
history: This idiom draws from Hindu mythology where Lord Ganesha, the elephant-headed deity and remover of obstacles, is believed to listen to devotees' prayers at the start of any endeavor.
note: References the benevolent listening attribute of Ganesha in Bengali Hindu culture.
